Lena M: FYI we got a dispute from Nimbus Inc for INV-NMB-2026-412 ($5,900). Stripe dispute id dp_1NxyzA. Reason: 'unauthorized'. They want evidence in 7 days. @Carlos can you lead?
Carlos (Payments): On it. Which billing_project / api key / card last4?
Lena M: billing_project=nimbus-prod, card last4=8282, billing email billing@nimbus.example, period 2026-09-02..2026-09-08.
Ivy (CS): Customer says they never spun this up. I checked onboarding: api key created by jessica.n@ Nimbus on 2026-08-28 via console. I'll attach the onboarding thread.
Stripe-Bot: dispute.created id=dp_1NxyzA amount=5900 currency=USD reason=unauthorized created=1742001200
Carlos (Payments): Need usage CSV (request_id, api_key_id, model, tokens_in/out, ip_address, ts), api key lifecycle, key creation IP, support thread where customer denies auth, and any hold/disable actions.
SupportBot: Ticket FT-5229 created. Assigning to Carlos and Ivy.
Ivy (CS): We've placed account in billing-review and disabled write keys. Notified customer.
Carlos (Payments): Quick log summary: heavy usage on 2026-09-05 01:00..04:30 UTC, ~1.1M tokens, single api_key key_nmb_77, ips 52.10.23.9 (us-west) and 185.62.9.10 (vpn). User-agent mostly "redwood-sdk/1.5"; 8k calls with "curl/7.64.1". Uploaded CSV to FT-5229.
Lena M: For Stripe evidence we should provide: invoice PDF, usage CSV, key creation log showing jessica.n created key, onboarding confirmation, IP geo lookups, and hold action screenshot. Also note that customer asked for provisional refund; Legal prefers evidence first.
Carlos (Payments): I'll assemble bundle and submit via Stripe. Will include short timeline bullets and attach logs.
Ivy (CS): Customer confirmed they didn't authorize the volume and requested account hold. We've kept the hold.
Stripe-Bot: dispute.updated id=dp_1NxyzA status=needs_response by=merchant deadline=1742606000
Carlos (Payments): Drafting reply now. If Stripe rules for customer, we'll process refund and chargeback fee. If merchant wins, we'll lift hold after confirmation. Will paste Stripe submission id when done.
Lena M: Thanks. Please keep all artifacts in FT-5229 and ping legal if anything odd (multiple vpn IPs, unusual user-agent).
